name: Wiki-Go
summary:
Every Wikipedia article becomes a card. The Eiffel Tower, the Mona Lisa, the lion, the Moon, the Titanic: millions of subjects drawn from Wikipedia, to collect from Common to Mythic (according to page views). Tear one open, reveal your cards one by one and watch for the glow of the rarest ones!

Independent game, not affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation. Wikipedia is a trademark of the Wikimedia Foundation.
